name: Long Wave Run-up Data
description: The stored data depicts measured run-up values done in a long wave flume at Franzius-Institute, Leibniz University Hannover. Further description can be taken from Goseberg et al (2013a) and Goseberg (2013b).
citation: Goseberg, Nils, 2014, "Long Wave Run-up Data", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/25063, Harvard Dataverse, V2
